Name: HotkeyWheel
Author: konghu66
Description:
Description（模组简介）一款星露谷物语快捷轮盘模组，一键唤出圆形快捷面板，自定义各类功能快捷键，无需反复记忆大量按键，大幅提升游戏操作效率。支持自定义槽位数量与功能名称，搭配可视化配置菜单轻松调整全部参数。
Installation instructions（安装教程） 安装 SMAPI 星露谷物语模组加载器； （可选）安装 Generic Mod Config Menu（GMCM）模组，用于游戏内可视化修改配置； 将本模组文件夹解压至游戏目录 Mods 文件夹内； 启动 SMAPI 进入游戏即可使用。
 Main features（核心功能） 
轮盘交互逻辑 按下绑定呼出键：弹出快捷键轮盘；再次按下呼出键，直接关闭轮盘（无任何按键触发） 轮盘弹出状态下，移动鼠标选中对应扇区，点击鼠标左键，执行该槽位绑定快捷键并自动关闭轮盘 
自定义槽位设置 可在配置中调整 2~12 个快捷槽位，修改数量后重启游戏生效 每个槽位独立设置触发快捷键，支持多按键组合绑定 每个槽位可自定义显示文字（如 “浇水壶”“传送回家”），文字为空时自动显示数字序号 
视觉自定义 自由调节轮盘整体半径大小，适配不同屏幕分辨率 鼠标悬停选中的扇区会放大高亮白色指示器、文字变黄区分 半透明黑色圆形底层背景，不遮挡游戏画面
 Requirements（前置需求） 游戏：星露谷物语 必备工具：SMAPI 模组加载器 模组：Generic Mod Config Menu（GMCM），用于游戏内可视化修改配置，不安装可手动编辑 config.json 文件修改设置
[heading]Main features[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Wheel Interaction Logic

Press the assigned toggle hotkey to pop up the shortcut wheel; press the toggle hotkey again to close the wheel without triggering any shortcuts.

While the wheel is open, move your mouse to select a sector, then left-click the mouse to activate the shortcut bound to that slot and automatically close the wheel.[/*]
[*]Custom Slot Settings

You can adjust the number of shortcut slots between 2 and 12 in the config. Restart the game for changes to take effect.

Each slot can be assigned an independent trigger hotkey, supporting multi-key combinations.

Custom display text can be set for each slot (e.g. "Watering Can", "Warp Home"). Numbers will be displayed automatically if the text field is left blank.[/*]
[*]Visual Customization

Freely adjust the overall radius of the wheel to fit all screen resolutions.

The sector hovered by the mouse will be highlighted with an enlarged white indicator and yellow text for differentiation.

A semi-transparent black circular background that will not block the game view.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Game: Official release of Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]Mandatory tool: SMAPI mod loader[/*]
[*]Optional dependency: Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM). Without it, you can edit
[code]config.json[/code]manually to adjust settings.[/*]
[/list]
